|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[R2-D2 & •C-3PO (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V3-L-r2d2c3po-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''Errata mark:''' the earliest image found already prints “E”: the PC had issued an errata of this card before its image repository began (8 July 2018), and no image of the earlier text was found. Listed with the [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription errors]] (marks that do not match the version).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-r2d2c3po022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/r2d2c3po.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Light/large/r2d2c3po.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “How Did We Get Into This Mess?”. Text: “If about to leave table (even from Overwhelmed) from Tatooine system and Stolen Data Tapes deployed on this character, may instead be relocated to Dune Sea. Immune to A Gift, Firepower, devices, and opponent's Interrupts.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[R2-D2 & •C-3PO (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 8 October 2022<ref name="img-r2d2c3poa48c2e8">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/r2d2c3po.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a48c2e81cc3088f72a385f3f4d68256d8012369f commit a48c2e8] (8 October 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Light/large/r2d2c3po.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “leave table (even from Overwhelmed) from Tatooine” → “leave table (for any reason, even if inactive) from Tatooine”; “Data Tapes deployed on this character, may instead be relocated to Dune” → “Data Tapes here (or at Dune Sea), relocate R2-D2 & C-3PO to Dune”; “A Gift, Firepower, devices, and” → “A Gift, devices, and”; the errata mark “E” → “E1”; the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “How Did We Get Into This Mess?”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “If about to leave table (for any reason, even if inactive) from Tatooine system and Stolen Data Tapes here (or at Dune Sea), relocate R2-D2 & C-3PO to Dune Sea. Immune to A Gift, devices, and opponent's Interrupts.”
